system.description:
You draw upon negative emotions allowing it to leak out and coalesce with your chakra turning it into strength. You make a single devastating swing with your weapon, with enough force to collapse the ground, and ignite the air ablaze around you.

Make a melee taijutsu attack, dealing your weapons damage + 7d12 Fire damage. Creatures within 15 feet of you must make a dexterity saving throw, taking the damage dealt on a failed save or half as much on a success.

Chain 3: For each creature that fails their saving throw, you regain 4 chakra, up to a maximum of this jutsu’s cost.
